2: name: obscura
3: description: Use Obscura — a Rust headless browser with a Chrome DevTools Protocol server — for fast page fetches, JS execution, scraping, and CDP automation. Drop-in CDP replacement for Chrome with Puppeteer or Playwright. 4: ---
5: 
6: # Obscura
7: 
8: Single-developer, open-source Rust headless browser. Boots instantly, ~70 MB binary, ~30 MB RAM at runtime, and serves a Chrome DevTools Protocol port that Puppeteer and Playwright connect to unchanged. **You swap the binary, not the code.**
9: 
10: Repo: https://github.com/h4ckf0r0day/obscura
11: 
12: ## Why pick Obscura over Chrome
13: 
14: | | Obscura | Chrome |
15: |---|---|---|
16: | Binary | ~70 MB | ~300 MB |
17: | RAM | ~30 MB | ~200 MB |
18: | Cold start | instant | ~2 s |
19: | Page load (upstream claim) | ~85 ms | varies |
20: 
21: Field measurement on Cloudflare-protected `nairaland.com` (warm fetch): **Obscura ~4.1–4.9 s, returns real HTML body**. Real Chrome over CDP: ~5.1 s warm / 9.3 s cold. `curl`: 0.5–0.9 s but only the CF challenge interstitial.
22: 
23: Obscura is roughly as fast as warm Chrome, ~2× faster cold, parallelizes far better because it doesn't carry Chrome's per-process overhead, and clears Cloudflare's basic JS challenge **without** the stealth feature.
24: 
25: ## Build
26: 
27: ```bash
28: git clone https://github.com/h4ckf0r0day/obscura.git
29: cd obscura
30: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/obscura-target cargo build -p obscura-cli --bin obscura --no-default-features
31: ```
32: 
33: Resulting binary: `/tmp/obscura-target/debug/obscura`
34: 
35: `--no-default-features` skips the stealth build. Stealth needs `cmake` locally because it pulls `wreq` / BoringSSL.
36: 
37: ### Stealth build
38: 
39: ```bash
40: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/obscura-target cargo build -p obscura-cli --bin obscura --features stealth
41: ```
42: 
43: What stealth gives you:
44: 
45: - **Per-session randomized fingerprints** — GPU, canvas, audio, battery
46: - **3,520 tracker domains blocked** (built-in blocklist)
47: - **`navigator.webdriver` masked**
48: - **Native functions patched** so common automation detectors can't unmask them via `Function.prototype.toString` inspection
49: - **TLS / HTTP-2 fingerprint** matching real Chromium (defeats most JA3/JA4 + ALPN-ordering bot management)
50: 
51: Use stealth against: Cloudflare Turnstile non-interactive, Akamai BMP, PerimeterX, DataDome.
52: Stealth still won't clear: hard interactive CAPTCHAs (Turnstile interactive, hCaptcha challenge), and fingerprinters using WebGPU/WebAssembly quirks not yet patched.
53: 
54: ## CLI fetch
55: 
56: ```bash
57: /tmp/obscura-target/debug/obscura fetch https://example.com/ --dump text --quiet
58: ```
59: 
60: Useful flags:
61: - `--dump text` — visible text only
62: - `--dump html` — full rendered DOM
63: - `--quiet` — suppress progress logs
64: - `--timeout <ms>` — per-page timeout
65: 
66: ## CDP server (Puppeteer / Playwright)
67: 
68: ```bash
69: /tmp/obscura-target/debug/obscura serve --port 9222
70: ```
71: 
72: **Playwright:**
73: 
74: ```ts
75: import { chromium } from "playwright-core";
76: 
77: const browser = await chromium.connectOverCDP("ws://127.0.0.1:9222");
78: const page = await browser.newContext().then((ctx) => ctx.newPage());
79: await page.goto("https://example.com/");
80: console.log(await page.title());
81: await browser.close();
82: ```
83: 
84: **Puppeteer:**
85: 
86: ```ts
87: import puppeteer from "puppeteer-core";
88: 
89: const browser = await puppeteer.connect({
90:   browserWSEndpoint: "ws://127.0.0.1:9222/devtools/browser",
91: });
92: const page = await browser.newPage();
93: await page.goto("https://example.com/");
94: console.log(await page.title());
95: await browser.disconnect();
96: ```
97: 
98: ## Scaling profile
99: 
100: - ✅ **High concurrency, low resource:** static + lightly-dynamic pages — hundreds of parallel fetches per box.
101: - ⚠️ **Medium:** JS-rendered SPAs, light bot protection — works but slower than raw HTTP, watch timeouts.
102: - ❌ **Low / unreliable:** aggressive bot defense (Turnstile interactive, Akamai BMP), real auth-walled apps, anything needing pixel-perfect rendering parity with Chrome.
103: 
104: ## Known limits
105: 
106: - Not full Chrome — some browser APIs and CDP methods are incomplete relative to upstream Chromium.
107: - Screenshot capture is not implemented (no layout/rendering engine).
108: - Authenticated pages need cookie or session injection via CDP; Obscura won't run interactive logins.
109: - Hard CAPTCHAs (Turnstile interactive, hCaptcha) require a human or a third-party solver.
110: 
111: ## Safety
112: 
113: Treat Obscura like any external Rust crate: `cargo build` runs dependency build scripts (V8, TLS). Build into a disposable target dir (`CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/obscura-target`) when evaluating new branches.
